$schema.description:
Ignored: a `"$schema": "https://.../server.config.json"` key so
editors with JSON Schema support (e.g. VS Code) offer completion
and inline docs while editing this file. See
`schema/server.config.json` and `docs/server.md#published-schema`.

allow_workspace_scripts.description:
Run served repositories' `[workspace]` scripts (branchyard.toml)
for new branches: `true` for every repository, or a list of
repository names. Off by default; see docs/workspace.md.

require_workspace_execution_presets.description:
Workspace session starts must name one of `execution_presets` and
may not carry `provider` or `provision`. Default false.

labels.description:
The labels this server's worker carries; it claims only operations
whose `require_labels` are all among them. See
docs/server.md#worker-labels.

inventory.description:
Detect the harnesses installed on this machine and advertise them,
with a `harness:<id>` label for each that can run. Default true. See
docs/harness-lifecycle.md.

unclaimable_after_seconds.description:
How long an operation may wait queued before it says why no live
worker can claim it. Default 60.

connectors.description:
The connector gateway (docs/connectors.md): where it is, which
bundles it serves, and whether this server runs it.

models.description:
The model gateway (docs/model-gateway.md): backends, routes,
budgets and prices, as `[models]` in branchyard.toml. A backend's
`key` names an entry of `secrets`, else a variable of this server.

ceilings.description:
Each principal's ceiling, by its name: the connectors, models and
hosts any branch acting for it may have at most, whatever a request
asks for (docs/model-gateway.md#one-scope).

approvals.description:
The administrator's locked approval policy and each principal's
(docs/effects.md#approvals).

aging_seconds.description:
Seconds an operation waits queued before its effective priority
rises by one, so low-priority work cannot starve; 0 turns aging
off. Default 60. See docs/server.md#scheduling.

fair_share_window_seconds.description:
Seconds a claim keeps counting toward its tenant's fair share (the
time constant of its exponential decay); 0 counts only running
operations. Default 300.

metrics.description:
Serve Prometheus metrics at /metrics (docs/observability.md). Off
without this.

public_url.description:
This server's URL as webhook senders reach it (behind a proxy, its
public address): the base of each event trigger's webhook URL.
Default: http(s)://<listen>. See docs/triggers.md.

allow_trigger_prechecks.description:
Let triggers of served repositories run a precheck command before
firing: `true` for every repository, or a list of repository names.
Off by default; see docs/triggers.md.

app.description:
The web companion at /app/ (docs/companion.md): `true`, or its
settings. Off by default.

sync.description:
Sync served repositories' branches to durable storage
(docs/sync.md): the remote, its encryption, how often and how fast.

ManagedKnowledge.description: Operator-owned storage for repository-free console projects.

enabled.description: Explicit operator opt-in; disabled by default.

max_source_bytes.description: Maximum original source bytes per workspace.

max_upload_bytes.description: Maximum size of one source upload.

tenant.description:
This principal's tenant; defaults to [`DEFAULT_TENANT`] when this
entry gives no tenant, scopes or repos of its own.

name.description: Defaults to `token_sha256`'s first 12 characters when omitted.

GoogleIdTokenConfig.description: Google-only ID-token admission, independent of Google API access tokens.

audience.description: Exact audience identifying this Branchyard server.

bindings.description: The only external identities admitted by this server.

GoogleIdentityBinding.description: An exact external identity mapped to existing server authorization policy.

issuer.description: Exact Google issuer, including its scheme when present.

subject.description: Exact Google subject identifier. No wildcard or email matching.

principal.description: Operator-controlled tenant, scopes and repository policy.

Principal.description:
Who a verified bearer token acts as: a tenant, a subject name, the
scopes it holds, and, optionally, a narrower repository allowlist than
its tenant's. Requests never carry a `tenant_id`; a principal's tenant
comes only from the credential that authenticated it. See
`docs/server.md#identity-and-scopes`.

origin.description: Authenticated origin, defaulting to static for older records.

name.description:
The subject this credential names, such as an operator or a CI
system; distinct from the tenant. Used for idempotency scoping and
audit, and appears in `Debug` and logs (never the token itself).

repos.description: `None` allows every repository its tenant allows.

AuthenticationOrigin.description: How a principal authenticated, persisted with queued work without its bearer.

oneOf.description: A configured or paired static credential. Never an external user assertion.
A delegated paired credential retaining its verified issuing identity.

subject.description: Stable issuing subject, never a generated device name.

oneOf.description: A Google-signed ID token matched an exact operator-configured binding.

subject.description: The verified external subject, never a display name or email.

audience.description: The server audience against which the token was verified.

weight.description:
The tenant's share of the queue against other tenants at the same
priority. Default 1.

max_priority.description:
The highest priority its operations may carry (-10 to 10); higher
requests are admitted at this. Default 10.

ExecutionPreset.description:
An operator-approved execution environment for workspace sessions, one
entry of `execution_presets`. A session start names its `id`; the server
supplies the provider, secrets and worker labels, and then applies the
same checks as to any request. See docs/server.md#execution-presets.

id.description: Stable ID a session start names: 1 to 64 of a-z, 0-9 and '-'.

provider.description:
The environment, in the form of a request's `provider`: `local`,
`substrate` or `microsandbox`. Its kind must be in `allow_providers`
(`local` always is). Relative paths resolve against this file's
directory.

harnesses.description: Harness or profile IDs a session may choose, matched exactly.

secrets.description: Names in `secrets` added to the session's provisioning.

tenants.description: Tenants that may use this preset. Absent: every tenant.

require_labels.description:
Worker labels every turn of the session requires, so it runs only
where this environment's files are.

Provider.description:
Where a branch's harness runs.

Serialized as an object tagged by `kind`, such as `{"kind": "local"}` or
`{"kind": "microsandbox", "image": "...", ...}`.

oneOf.description: A local process as your user; no isolation. The default.

A Microsandbox microVM per turn, booted from an image that has the
harness installed. Needs a build with the `microsandbox` feature and
a Linux host with KVM.

An Agent Substrate actor per turn, from a template that runs the
Branchyard bridge and has the harness installed. Unqualified: see
`docs/substrate.md`.

A machine an environment recipe's scripts make, per turn (or kept
paused between turns when the recipe can suspend and resume),
reached over ssh or the recipe's exec command; the worktree and the
private home are copied in and back. See `docs/recipes.md`.

SandboxKeep.description: What happens to a branch's sandbox when a turn ends.

oneOf.description: Destroyed: every turn gets a fresh one.

Paused and recorded, and resumed by the next turn, when the provider
can pause; destroyed otherwise, saying why.

SandboxOptions.description: A sandboxed harness's image, limits and credentials.

image.description:
OCI image reference. The harness executable must be installed in it
and on its `PATH`, or named by an absolute guest path in
[`TaskOptions::command`].

pass_env.description:
Variables copied by name from this process into the sandbox, such as
`ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`. Nothing else is: not your login, not your
`HOME`. Names are stored with the branch; values are not.

keep.description:
What happens to the branch's microVM when a turn ends: destroyed
(the default), or paused and resumed by the next turn. Needs
[`SandboxOptions::live_branch`]; see `docs/sandbox-snapshots.md`.

snapshots.description:
With a kept sandbox, how many checkpoints keep a provider snapshot
as well (the newest; older ones are released). Unset: 3. 0: none.

max_paused.description:
At most this many kept (paused) sandboxes of this provider in the
repository; parking one more destroys the least recently used.
Unset: 4.

max_kept_secs.description:
A kept sandbox unused for longer than this many seconds is
destroyed instead of resumed: by the branch's next turn, or by the
next turn ending on this provider. Unset: kept until `max_paused`
evicts it. See `docs/sandbox-snapshots.md`.

live_branch.description:
Opt in to the Microsandbox SDK's pause, resume, live branching and
full-memory snapshots, which are declared only then: unqualified
until they pass on a KVM host.

SubstrateEgress.description: The destinations actors may reach through Substrate's egress gateway.

oneOf.description: Allow DNS names, optionally beginning with `*.` for one subdomain label.
Allow all destinations, selected explicitly by the operator.

SubstrateOptions.description:
Where an Agent Substrate cluster is and how a harness runs in it.

Each turn creates an actor from [`SubstrateOptions::template`], copies the
worktree into it at [`SubstrateOptions::workdir`] and the branch's private
home to [`SubstrateOptions::home`], runs the harness there through the
bridge, copies both back and deletes the actor. See `docs/substrate.md`.

endpoint.description:
The `Control` API, as `https://host:port`, or `http://host:port` on
loopback or with [`SubstrateOptions::insecure`].

router.description:
The router base URL. The bridge requests carry the actor routing
header. Use `https://` or `wss://`, or `http://` or `ws://` on
loopback or with [`SubstrateOptions::insecure`].

atespace.description: The atespace actors are created in. Empty means `default`.

template.description:
An actor template that runs `branchyard-bridge` with the public half
of [`SubstrateOptions::key`], with git and the harness installed.

key.description:
The host's bridge signing key, from `branchyard-bridge keygen`. The
path is stored with the branch; the key is not.

api_token_file.description: Path to a Control bearer token, reread for every RPC.

server_name.description: Verified TLS service name for Control, also through a port-forward.

egress.description: Outgoing connections actors may make through Substrate.

workdir.description: Where the worktree is placed in the actor. Empty means `/workspace`.

home.description: The harness's `HOME` in the actor. Empty means `/branchyard/home`.

pass_env.description:
Variables copied by name from this process into the actor, such as
`ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`. Names are stored with the branch; values are
not.

ca.description:
PEM certificate authorities for a TLS `Control` API, and for the
router unless [`SubstrateOptions::router_ca`] is set. Unset trusts
the public roots bundled at build time.

client_cert.description: A PEM client certificate and key for the `Control` API (mutual TLS).

router_ca.description: PEM certificate authorities for a TLS router.

insecure.description:
Allow a `Control` endpoint or router in the clear to a host other
than loopback, sending credentials and code unencrypted.

keep.description:
What happens to the branch's actor when a turn ends: deleted (the
default), or paused (`PauseActor`) and resumed by the next turn. See
`docs/sandbox-snapshots.md`.

snapshots.description:
With a kept actor, how many checkpoints keep a tag as well (the
newest; older tags are deleted). Unset: 3. 0: none.

max_paused.description:
At most this many kept actors in the repository for this cluster;
parking one more deletes the least recently used. Unset: 4.

max_kept_secs.description:
A kept sandbox unused for longer than this many seconds is
destroyed instead of resumed: by the branch's next turn, or by the
next turn ending on this provider. Unset: kept until `max_paused`
evicts it. See `docs/sandbox-snapshots.md`.

RecipeOptions.description:
An environment recipe a branch's harness runs on, as it was trusted when
the branch was given it: its commands are stored with the branch, so
every later turn, its recovery and its removal run what was trusted,
not what the configuration says by then. Resolved and trust-checked by
the caller (`by run --provider recipe:NAME`); see `docs/recipes.md`.

digest.description: The SHA-256 of the commands that were trusted, for messages.

workdir.description:
Where the worktree is placed on the machine. Empty means
`/tmp/branchyard/<branch>-<8 hex>/workspace`, unique to this
repository's branch.

home.description:
The harness's `HOME` on the machine. Empty means the same directory's
`home`.

pass_env.description:
Variables copied by name from this process to the machine. Names
are stored with the branch; values are not.

keep.description:
Destroy the machine when a turn ends (the default), or suspend it
for the next turn; pausing needs both `suspend` and `resume`.

max_paused.description:
At most this many kept machines of this recipe in the repository;
parking one more destroys the least recently used. Unset: 4.

max_kept_secs.description:
A kept sandbox unused for longer than this many seconds is
destroyed instead of resumed: by the branch's next turn, or by the
next turn ending on this provider. Unset: kept until `max_paused`
evicts it. See `docs/sandbox-snapshots.md`.

PresetHarness.description: One harness an execution preset offers, and the models it may run.

harness.description:
A harness or profile ID, matched exactly: `claude-code` does not
admit `claude-code-acp`.

models.description: Models a session may choose. Absent: a session may not choose one.

default_model.description:
The model a session runs when it names none. Default: the first of
`models`.

id.description: Defaults to the URL when omitted.

gateway.description:
The gateway's canonical `/mcp` URL, such as
`http://127.0.0.1:8931/mcp`: every token's audience.

sandbox_gateway.description: The gateway as a sandboxed harness reaches it.

issuer.description: Every token's issuer. Default: this server's URL.

signing_key.description:
The signing key, a private JSON Web Key Set made if missing.
Default: `<data_dir>/gateway/key`. Its public keys are served at
`GET /.well-known/jwks.json`.

bundles.description: The bundle root the gateway serves.

anvil.description: Anvil's command and leading arguments. Default `["anvil"]`.

run_gateway.description: Run the gateway beside the server, supervised. Default false.

listen.description:
The address the gateway listens on when run here, when not
loopback.

vault_key.description:
The gateway's vault key (a 0600 file of 64 hex characters).
Default: `<data_dir>/gateway/vault.key`, made if missing.

effects_proxy.description:
Call the gateway through each turn's effect-ledger proxy, which
decides approvals and writes every effectful call to the ledger
before it is made (docs/effects.md). Default true.

effects_listen.description:
The address each turn's ledger proxy, and a sandboxed turn's
delegation endpoint, binds. Default `127.0.0.1`.

effects_sandbox_host.description:
How a sandboxed harness reaches this host (a host address its guest
routes to), where its ledger proxy and its delegation endpoint
listen. Without it, a sandboxed turn calls the gateway directly and
its effects reach the ledger only from the audit log, and a
sandboxed harness gets no delegation tools.

allow.description:
Models a new branch may call through the gateway when
`--model-gateway` gives none, as globs (`"claude-*"`, `"*"`); set,
it puts new branches on the gateway.

routes.description: Routes by requested model, first match wins: `[[models.routes]]`.

budget.description: Daily and monthly limits (UTC) over every branch of the repository.

prices.description:
Prices for models the catalog does not price, dollars per million
tokens, by model id or glob.

listen.description:
The address a turn's gateway listens on (default `127.0.0.1`);
`0.0.0.0` for sandboxes to reach it.

sandbox_host.description:
The host a sandboxed harness reaches the gateway at. Without it, a
sandboxed branch on the gateway fails its turn.

seed.description: Seeds the weighted choice of backends.

audit.description:
What is kept of each call besides its interception record (sizes, a
digest of the request, tools offered and called, why it stopped):
`digests` (the default) keeps no text; `contents` also writes each
call's request and response to `.branchyard/models/audit/`.

url.description:
Its base URL (default: the provider's public API; a generic
backend needs one).

key.description:
The secret holding its key, by name: an entry of `[secrets]`, else
a variable of that name. Never the key itself.

header.description:
A generic backend's key header (default `authorization`, as
`Bearer <key>`).

compat.description:
What the gateway adapts for an endpoint that imitates OpenAI's API
with differences: `gemini` for Gemini's OpenAI-compatible endpoint
(the fields it refuses stripped, the thought signatures it puts on
tool calls kept and put back when a request replays them),
`versioned` for an endpoint whose URL already names the API's
version, as Z.ai's do (a path's leading `/v1` is dropped, nothing
else changes), or `none`. Default: `gemini` for an `openai` backend
whose URL's host is `generativelanguage.googleapis.com`, `versioned`
for one whose host is `api.z.ai`, else `none`.

model.description: A glob over the requested model, such as `claude-*`.

fallbacks.description:
Tried in order after the weighted backends, on a refused
connection, a 5xx or a 429.

requests_per_minute.description:
At most this many requests a minute through this route, per
process.

backend_model.description:
The model to ask a backend of another API for: a request for a
Claude model translated for an OpenAI backend asks it for this
model. Without it a route never crosses APIs.

alert_at.description: The share of a limit at which an alert is recorded (default 0.8).

oneOf.description:
Sizes, a digest of the request, the tools offered and called, and
why the response stopped, per call. No prompt or answer text.

Also each call's request and response, one JSON line per call in
`.branchyard/models/audit/<branch>/<turn>.jsonl` (the directory
0700, the file 0600), never in the event log.

FileCeiling.description: One principal's ceiling. Unset parts leave that scope as requested.

connectors.description: The widest connector grant, in `--connector` form (`github:read`).

models.description:
The models its branches may call through the model gateway, as
globs (`claude-*`).

network.description:
The hosts its branches may reach, as `--network` rules; `[]` is
none.

FileApprovals.description:
`approvals`: the administrator's locked policy and the people's
(docs/effects.md#approvals).

admin.description:
Locked: nothing below it can loosen it, and only it may change how
deletions are treated.

people.description: Each principal's policy, by its name.

rules.description:
Pattern to `allow`, `ask`, `block` or `stage`: a tool name glob
(`Bash`), or `connector:operation` (`github:issues.*`).

classes.description:
Effect class (`reversible`, `compensable`, `irreversible`) to a
decision, for operations no rule names.

deletion.description: How deletions are treated; honoured only in `admin`.

listen.description:
A separate plain-HTTP listener (`IP:port`) serving only /metrics,
as `--metrics-addr` sets it.

token.description:
A token that reads /metrics and nothing else, at least 16
characters. Exactly one of `token` and `token_file`, or neither.

FileApp.description:
`app`: `true`/`false`, or the companion's settings (which turn it on
unless `enabled` is false).

push.description: Send Web Push notifications to subscribed browsers. Default true.

vapid_key.description:
The VAPID private key, made if missing. Default:
`<data_dir>/companion/vapid.pk8`.

push_subject.description:
The VAPID contact, `mailto:` or `https:`. Default: `public_url` when
https, else mailto:branchyard@localhost.

push_services.description:
Push service hosts subscriptions may name (`host` or `*.suffix`).
Default: FCM, Mozilla, Windows and Apple push services.

FileSync.description: `sync`: the same keys as `[sync]` in branchyard.toml, and the lease.

encrypt.description:
`none` (the default), `passphrase` (from
BRANCHYARD_SYNC_PASSPHRASE or `passphrase_file`), or a `kms://` URL.

algorithm.description:
`aes-256-gcm` (the default) or `chacha20-poly1305`, for a new
encrypted remote.

interval.description: How often to look for changes to push, such as `30s`. Default `1m`.

bandwidth.description: Bytes a second, up and down together, such as `10MB/s`.

concurrency.description: Objects in flight at once. Default 8.

retention.description:
Delete a task this long after its last change, such as `90d`,
unless held.

grace.description:
How long an unreferenced object waits before collection. Default
`24h`.

quota.description: The stored bytes the remote may hold, such as `50GB`.

device.description:
This server's name in conflict branches and leases. Default: the
host name and a random suffix.

lease_seconds.description: Seconds a task's lease lasts between renewals. Default 60.
